stances.quote: My kids were pointing out this morning that when school lunch was free for everybody during the pandemic the line moved fast and everybody had enough time to eat. Now that they’re back to charging, kids have about 3 minutes or less to shovel the food in their face or miss recess

stances.summary: Criticizes healthcare system pricing for children's medication
stances.quote:
5 yo woke up with a fever. CVS Minute Clinic says she has flu, prescribes tamaflu. 

It’s the New Year so the new deductible kicks in. Pharmacy wants $198 for the tamaflu. If we didn’t have it, like millions don’t, she’d go without it, putting her life at risk. Barbaric.

stances.summary: Criticizes progressive leaders treating grassroots organizations as hostile
stances.quote: If a grassroots organization of 120,000 people that largely agrees with you, which has beaten a slew of powerful Democrats and elected mayors in NYC and Seattle in recent months, is considered hostile to you, what is the point of mass politics? Disagreement is one thing. Outright
